name: Formula One
description: Formula One from the first world championship of 1950 to today: the great drivers, teams and races of motor racing's top series.

checkpoints.name: The first champions
checkpoints.note: The world championship begins in 1950. Fangio wins five titles, Ferrari races from the start, and drivers risk their lives every weekend on circuits with few barriers.

checkpoints.name: Speed and danger
checkpoints.note: Sponsors' colours arrive, Lauda survives his crash, and the duels of Prost and Senna at McLaren make Formula One a world television sport.

checkpoints.name: Ferrari and Schumacher
checkpoints.note: The deaths at Imola change safety for good. Michael Schumacher and Ferrari win five titles in a row.

checkpoints.name: The modern era
checkpoints.note: Vettel's Red Bull, then Hamilton's Mercedes, then Verstappen dominate. Drive to Survive brings new fans, and races spread to the Gulf and the United States.
